title: AsmSdk scenario
description: One scenario of tests/scenarios: the commands ScenarioTests runs, in order, on a fresh copy of the scenario's folder, and what each must produce. See docs/ecosystem/scenarios.md.

description.description: What the scenario proves, in a sentence or two. It is written at the top of the test's log.

rids.description: The build machines the scenario runs on, by RID. Leave it out for every machine AsmSdk builds for; elsewhere the test is skipped with the reason.

services.description: Containers to start before the first step (docker run, published on a free port of 127.0.0.1) and to remove after the last. The scenario is skipped where Docker cannot run Linux containers of their platform.

image.description: The image with a pinned tag, for example ghcr.io/asmfoundation/kvasm:0.3.0.

port.description: The container port to publish; {port:name} expands to the host port it gets.

ready.description: Text the container's log shows once it serves; the steps wait for it. Without it they wait until the port accepts a connection.

steps.description: The commands, in order. The first that does not produce what it must fails the scenario.

run.description: The command line, run in the scenario's folder without a shell: whitespace separates arguments, and double or single quotes group them. dotnet gets the test environment (the isolated NuGet cache). A path with a slash is a file of the scenario's folder (on Windows .exe, .cmd or .bat is tried when it has no extension); any other name is looked up on PATH. Placeholders: {rid}, {exe:name}, {lib:name}, {port:service}.

description.description: Why the step is there, for the test's log.

exitCode.description: The exit status the command must return.

stdout.description: Texts that must each appear in the command's standard output. Placeholders are allowed.

files.description: Files or folders, relative to the scenario's folder with forward slashes, that must exist after the command. Placeholders are allowed.
